meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 当安装此技能后，Claude 被要求分析代码库时，会把代码按功能分组，绘制各功能的流程图，找出不同功能间重复的部分，提出合并方案，并输出后续修改计划。
howto.when: 当你说“找到理想路径”“统一重复系统”或要求重构前审计架构时触发。

say.text: 找到这个代码库的理想路径
say.note: 开始映射代码库并生成流程图。
分析重复并给出统一方案。

say.text: 重构前审计当前的架构
say.note: 生成流程图和重复报告。

howto.what_en: Maps codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, detects duplicate concerns, proposes unified architecture, and outputs /make-plan prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to 'find the ideal path', 'unify duplicate systems', or 'audit architecture before refactoring'.

say_en.text: Find the ideal path for this codebase.

say_en.note: Analyzes duplication and proposes a unified plan.

say_en.text: Audit the current architecture before a refactor.
say_en.note: Produces a duplication report and architecture proposal.
